_about: Cyclohexanone (1) + p-Xylene (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of cyclohexanone, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of cyclohexanone, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Gao, J.[Jun], Zhang, K.[Kai], Xu, D.[Dongmei], Zhang, L.[Lianzheng], Chen, N.[Nannan], Li, C.[Chunlu], Isobaric Vapor Liquid Equilibrium for Binary Systems of Cyclohexanone + Benzene, Cyclohexanone + Toluene, and Cyclohexanone + p-Xylene at 101.3 kPa, J. source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0032. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
